title: Convert text strictly and preserve a recovery path
goal: Distinguish UTF-8 bytes/characters from ASCII and ISO-8859-1; detect invalid or unrepresentable input.
challenge: Identify the correct source encoding, recover an independently specified payload, and explain a rejected conversion. Retain actual outputs/statuses and preserve originals; report reasoning through self-review, not a score.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/foundation-encoding.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && umask 077; here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/foundation-encoding.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700; }; fresh() { here && test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test ! -e "$1" && test ! -L "$1"; }; regular() { here && test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$1")" = learner:600:1; }; here && test "$(df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1)" -ge 1073741824 && pwd
steps.explanation: Record this unique guest-only workspace. On Resume re-establish the recorded path/definitions; never overwrite another exercise.
steps.expected: Private learner-owned700 directory and observed1GiB free admission.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/utf8.txt" && fresh "$w/source.sha" && printf "caf\303\251\n" > utf8.txt && sha256sum utf8.txt > source.sha && wc -c utf8.txt && env LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 wc -m utf8.txt && od -An -tx1 utf8.txt
steps.explanation: This fixed original is café plus newline: six bytes, five Unicode characters in UTF-8. ASCII is a subset, not a synonym.
steps.expected: Actual byte/character counts and independent octets.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/latin1.txt" && fresh "$w/roundtrip.txt" && fresh "$w/expected-latin1.txt" && timeout -k 1s 10s iconv -f UTF-8 -t ISO-8859-1 utf8.txt > latin1.txt && printf "caf\351\n" > expected-latin1.txt && cmp expected-latin1.txt latin1.txt && timeout -k 1s 10s iconv -f ISO-8859-1 -t UTF-8 latin1.txt > roundtrip.txt && cmp utf8.txt roundtrip.txt
steps.explanation: Convert to a separate path with known input encoding, then compare independent bytes and round-trip. Wrong source declarations can produce valid wrong text.
steps.expected: Exact expected Latin-1 and restored UTF-8.

steps.command: foundation_step() { here && fresh "$w/ascii-partial.txt" && fresh "$w/ascii-error.txt" || return 19; if timeout -k 1s 10s iconv -f UTF-8 -t ASCII utf8.txt > ascii-partial.txt 2> ascii-error.txt; then return 1; else test $? = 1 && test -s ascii-error.txt && sha256sum -c source.sha; fi; }; foundation_step
steps.explanation: ASCII cannot represent this é. Retain error and any partial output; do not use //IGNORE to claim a lossless repair.

hints: Wrong declared source can yield valid but wrong text; //IGNORE/transliteration are not permitted repairs; nonzero status may leave partial output.
Choose command scope deliberately; compare known bytes and actual statuses, not only a successful-looking display.
Retain before evidence; refuse collisions and restore exact policy state before leaving. Guest root can bypass guest-side guards.
review: I demonstrated the selected mode’s actual observations and retained an incorrect or incomplete case.
I preserved originals and can explain the reasoning and limitations; this records self-review, not automatic assessment.
I restored any changed default/zone and retained the exact workspace without touching unrelated files.
coverage: LPIC-1 active v5.0 partial 107.3 iconv/encoding terms. No complete-objective coverage or endorsement.
